answer: Pay rewards convexly. Each agent locks POA in a sable vault, an opaque time-lock no one can drain early, and earns the square of that lock, capped at a ceiling so whales cannot dominate. Below the cap, splitting a stake S across n clones yields n(S/n)^2 = S^2/n, so every extra identity divides the farm's income. Unspent rewards add layers to the lock like a pearl. The chain weighs each vault by its nadir, the lowest balance held over the last 30 epochs, so coins shuffled between clones count for nothing.
